events.action: {"message": "Fixed the defect in `spsc_pbuf_write` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/lib/os/spsc_pbuf.c` where an `outlen` of `0` returned by `spsc_pbuf_alloc` (indicating 0 available bytes in the buffer) was returned directly instead of `-ENOMEM`. Changed the condition `outlen <= 0 ? outlen : -ENOMEM` to `outlen < 0 ? outlen : -ENOMEM` so that negative error codes from `spsc_pbuf_alloc` are propagated while insufficient space (including `0`) returns `-ENOMEM`. All tests in `tests/lib/spsc_pbuf` now pass.", "kind": "FinishAction"}

events.observation: {"content": [{"cache_prompt": false, "type": "text", "text": "Fixed the defect in `spsc_pbuf_write` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/lib/os/spsc_pbuf.c` where an `outlen` of `0` returned by `spsc_pbuf_alloc` (indicating 0 available bytes in the buffer) was returned directly instead of `-ENOMEM`. Changed the condition `outlen <= 0 ? outlen : -ENOMEM` to `outlen < 0 ? outlen : -ENOMEM` so that negative error codes from `spsc_pbuf_alloc` are propagated while insufficient space (including `0`) returns `-ENOMEM`.
